result.stdout:
wmd - Watermedoc

Usage:
  wmd build <source> -o <output> [options]
  wmd validate <source> [--strict]
  wmd help
  wmd version

Build options:
  -o, --output <dir>       Output directory for the Next.js project
  --title <title>          Site title
  --description <text>     Site description
  --repo <url>             Repository URL
  --base-url <path>        Base path for GitHub Pages style hosting
  --clean                  Delete the output directory before generating
  --strict                 Return non-zero exit code when there are warnings

Validate options:
  --strict                 Treat warnings as errors
